name: com.xploit.game_ui
description: Build your game's UI with HTML, CSS and JavaScript and render it on the GPU inside Unity. A native runtime (V8, lexbor, Yoga, Skia) paints the document straight onto Unity's D3D12 device, produces a frame only when something changed, and redraws only the part that changed. No Gameface, Ultralight or Vuplex, and no embedded browser.

samples.description: A complete game HUD: the page, the game script, and the bridge between them.
